turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm training for a marathon and my calf has been feeling tight for three days.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Tightness can turn into an injury if you push through. Do you want to rest for a few days, or switch to easy cross training like cycling?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One sec, I'm going to talk with my neighbor. Please wait until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam, which one did you like better, the blue one or the grey one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The grey one drove nicer. The blue one felt kind of heavy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: But the blue one has a bigger boot. We need space for the dog.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: True. The dog doesn't care how it drives.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we go back and test drive them again tomorrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Let's do it in the morning, before the dealership gets busy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. I'll call them first thing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, for your marathon calf, total rest or cross training?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Changing the subject, I'm setting up a phone for my mom. She's not great with tech. Any tips?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Make the text and icons bigger in the display settings first. That alone helps a lot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect, I'll do that this weekend.
